github-actions.description: Workflows live in .depot/workflows/ (Depot CI), which the manager's default patterns do not cover; the action.yaml pattern re-adds composite-action coverage in case patterns replace rather than extend the defaults.

packageRules.description: svelte-check and vue-tsc embed the TypeScript JS compiler API, which typescript 7 (native) no longer ships; hold these apps at 6.x until the framework checkers support TS 7 (expected ~7.1)

wrangler and @cloudflare/vite-plugin ship as a matched pair (the plugin pins the miniflare/workerd runtime to a specific wrangler release), so group every update type into a single PR that moves both packages across all apps together
